correctness.rationale: The recurrence h_n=(-1)^{s2(n)}h_{n-1}+h_{n-2} has an exact signed dyadic-block action on 2 signs x 16 initial pairs x 4 residues. Reconstructed four-step products become periodic after level two and an exact characteristic annihilator (X-16)(X-1)(X^2-X+16) holds on four base phases; primitive states yield leading projector (1,2,1,2)/6 and O(2^(r/2)) block error. Aligned dyadic decomposition extends frequencies to all N, not merely powers two. The four rational generating fractions and a noncancelled denominator 1-3z^2+4z^4 establish exponent 1/2 as sharp. Independently reimplemented the 128-coordinate transfer and verified the lag-16 identity on all coordinates for levels 3,4,5,6; this finite algebra is propagated by the proven level-4 operator, not merely by finite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Lipka and Ulas (2021 arXiv/2022 journal) establish automaticity of the same signed recurrence modulo any modulus and an explicit modulo-four automaton. Their inspected full source does not state natural densities (1/6,1/3,1/6,1/3), complete dyadic rational count series, nor the sharp O(sqrt N) discrepancy. Automaticity alone does not imply these quantitative results; searches do not certify priority.
residual_risks: An unindexed downstream computation from the published automaton could reproduce the same rational count statistics.
Modulus four and stated initial conditions only; sharpness rules out improving global power exponent, not all selected subsequence bounds.
